prompt:
Create ONE original transparent PNG sprite atlas for ASHVEIL's SOWER, the EXACT SAME 4-LEGGED industrial agricultural machine in the provided own-IP references. This is not the slender three-legged Surveyor or six-legged Culler. Keep the reference wide square dark iron chassis, four chunky brass hydraulic drive legs with four round tread footpads total, two fixed asymmetric pale olive riveted tanks (one TALL vertical ribbed cylinder and one SHORT squat round drum), attached curved hoses, one small downward-looking rectangular twin optical sensor on the FRONT, lower seed injection outlet and two small folded calibration tools under the belly (tools are not extra legs and never human arms/hands/fists). The REAR has a square dark ventilation grille, no front eyes. No redesign or added turret/arms. On FRONT/down views tall tank is viewer LEFT, short tank viewer RIGHT. On REAR/up views tall tank viewer RIGHT, short tank viewer LEFT. On left-facing three-quarter views match reference left-facing tank arrangement (tall on image left, short on image right); right-facing is the opposite. Rich restrained hand-painted pixel-art texture at native detail, tarnished brass pistons, dull grey plates, consistent diffuse ambient illumination. No colored glow, sparks, blast, dust, exhaust, emitted seeds, plants, floor, puddle, ground shadow, text, numbers, guides or extra objects. REAL alpha transparency outside machine.
STRICT LAYOUT: exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 COMPLETE independent poses. Row1 faces DOWN/toward viewer; row2 faces LEFT; row3 faces RIGHT; row4 faces UP/away. Each row is one animation ordered left-to-right. Camera fixed to low top-down 3/4 RPG perspective. Keep facing absolutely fixed per row, tanks fixed to chassis, optical vs rear grille correct even in compressed poses. Each of 16 cells must have very large clear transparent margins on ALL sides. Machine body width at most 60 percent of cell width and body height at most 70 percent of cell height. Four separated rows, no touching neighboring silhouette or canvas edge; complete footpads and tanks, no cropping. Intended atlas 1536x1536 with generous internal space; never pack large machines edge-to-edge. Same body construction, dimensions and texture across every frame. Four unique purposeful poses per row, not duplicated idle. Honest hydraulic mechanics: planted footpads support weight, far legs can be naturally occluded, no detached feet, extra legs, rubber hoses replacing legs, floating chassis or impossible floor penetration. Render body only; engine supplies movement and ground shadows.

ACTION = SELF-POWERED HYDRAULIC RESTART AND STAND, NOT reverse copies of fall. Draw four NEW distinct purposeful poses: 0 disabled low body with all four legs folded and feet prepared beneath mass; 1 front pair of footpads plant wider while rear pistons begin loading, chassis nose starts lifting; 2 rear pair extend and lift weight through an asymmetric but stable three/four-pad support transition, tanks move rigidly with chassis; 3 complete stable upright four-legged reference-like stance. Show changed pad placement, strut angle and deliberate thrust sequence rather than simple image translation or reversed falling. Preserve original facing and sensor placement throughout; no human assistance or ground object. Final proportions/height match canonical idle.
